profile: A warm grandmother telling a bedtime story, gentle smile in the voice
persona: A warm grandmother telling a bedtime story, gentle smile in the voice

lines.text: Pip made cups for the whole windowsill.
And every cup she made was perfect.
So when one broke, she did what perfect people do.
In an old country, broken cups are mended with gold.
The crack was not the end of the cup.
It was the part that caught the morning.

omni.ref_text: Long ago, when the hills were young, the lanterns of the valley were lit by hand, one by one, every single evening.
